name: SimpleX Server
description: SimpleX Chat is a private messenger with no user IDs or phone numbers. Your messages and files travel to your contacts through relay servers. SimpleX Server runs your own relays on your Runtipi, so they pass through hardware you control instead of someone else's servers:
short_desc: Run your own private relay servers for SimpleX Chat
author: SimpleX Chat

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
